name: Chemical injection system
description: Chemical injection skids dose inhibitors into the well stream or flowline to maintain flow assurance, separation performance and asset integrity. SPEC describes a 'Skid with dosing pumps and tank that injects chemicals into the process' supplied with the process equipment or standalone. The kill wing valve on a tree is primarily used to inject corrosion inhibitors or methanol to prevent hydrate formation.
